rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
rm -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/2html" rm -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/html2"
ln -s 2xml "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/2html" ln -s xml2 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/html2"
